name: Kiribati Fish Limited tuna processing plant

sources.evidence: The Kiribati Ministry of Fisheries & Ocean Resources reported on 17 March 2026 that the SPC Director-General delegation visited the Kiribati Fish Limited tuna processing plant in Tarawa, explicitly confirming the current physical plant and tuna-processing activity.
sources.publisher: Ministry of Fisheries & Ocean Resources, Kiribati

sources.evidence: The Ministry's Seafood Verification Division lists KFL with one processing plant among establishments that are approved and currently operating under its designated listing, providing current regulator evidence of operational status.
sources.publisher: Ministry of Fisheries & Ocean Resources, Kiribati

sources.evidence: The Ministry's KFL state-owned-enterprise page states that Kiribati Fish Ltd completed a fish processing plant on Tarawa and identifies it as the joint venture's onshore processing facility.
sources.publisher: Ministry of Fisheries & Ocean Resources, Kiribati
